title: Anduril feature tile
description: One wide media tile on the black page, right under the hero: a 3:1 letterbox on desktop, a square on phones, 2px corners, a long dark scrim and a bold name bottom left. It fades in as it enters the view; on hover (desktop) a tagline and ↗ arrow open under the name and decode.
notes: needs JavaScript (hydrate: visible) only for the tagline decode
name: anduril-feature
